news.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh sharpens inflation warning at Jackson Hole, signaling possible rate hike
news.description: After confusing markets at his July news conference, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh used Jackson Hole to give a clearer view of the case for higher interest rates.

news.title: Trump loses bid to transfer New York hush money case to federal court
news.description: Trump's conviction in the hush money case relates to conduct that preceded the 2016 presidential election, which led to his first term in the White House.

news.title: Apple hikes subscription prices for Apple TV and Apple One in the U.S.
news.description: Apple raised prices for Apple Music by $1 per month in July, citing licensing costs.
